The Imperial '''Saber Program''' was a government program set up to recruit special [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to be [[Saber Guard]]s for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They would act as a special security force against other force users. The [[Acolyte Program]], which produced the [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s, apparently had some ties to the Saber Program.
